name: Hitozuma Kyonyuu San Shimai
source:
Yusaku has a grudge against Jouichiro. To revenge on him, he secretly starts working at his house as a butler. His goal is to eliminate him and get all his money. There are three daughters of him. They are all married and live at his house. At first, he decides to make them his sex slaves....

[From ErogeShop]
